declaration_consumer.appendix8_line_030: total related acquisition, disposal, storage and redemption expenses by operation category
declaration_consumer.appendix8_line_040: total expenses accepted in reduction of category income
declaration_consumer.section2_line_050: accepted expenses from Appendix 8 line 040 plus accepted current-period loss

authority.conclusion: Eligible expenses are documented, actually incurred expenses connected with acquisition, disposal, storage or redemption; the list includes professional-participant services and exchange fees.

Financial result is income less corresponding expenses. Expenses not directly attributable to an operation class or income type are allocated by each income type's income share; if that income type has no income in the expense period, recognition is deferred until income exists.
On disposal, expense in the form of securities acquisition cost is recognized from the earliest acquisitions under FIFO.

The Code expressly prescribes proportional acquisition-cost recognition for partial nominal-value redemption, but does not state an equivalent rule for acquisition commission on an ordinary partial quantity disposal.
Foreign-currency deductible expense is converted at the official Bank of Russia rate on the actual expense date.
For expenses incurred outside the tax agent, acquisition/storage expense recognition requires the taxpayer's application and documents proving transaction/title, payment and amount.

Broker-to-broker transfer information includes acquisition dates and acquisition/storage expenses in relation to each security; it does not prescribe a per-unit or partial-disposal commission formula.
Appendix 8 consumes category totals at lines 020, 030 and 040; it does not consume trade/fee relation records.
Current FNS guidance confirms that securities income is reduced by acquisition, disposal, storage and redemption expenses.
Archived FNS guidance corroborates per-operation and per-category results and explicit commission eligibility; current Code text controls.
